description: This file provides utilities for handling Microsoft Teams mentions, including parsing mention syntax, building mention entities, and formatting mention text.

methods.name: parseMentions
methods.description: Parses text to identify mentions in the format @[Name](id), converting them to <at> tags and extracting mention metadata.

methods.name: buildMentionEntities
methods.description: Creates mention entity objects from a list of MentionInfo objects.

methods.name: formatMentionText
methods.description: Formats plain text by replacing @Name mentions with <at>Name</at> tags.
